summary: BBVA filed a Form 6-K disclosing that its Board of Directors resolved a cash interim dividend of €0.37 gross per share against the 2026 dividend, payable 15 October 2026. Net dividend is €0.2997 after 19% withholding. Key dates: last trading 12 October, ex-dividend 13 October, record 14 October. No advisor or board recommendation is cited. This is a routine capital-return communication rather than a special situation; no stake, premium, or deal terms are involved. Watch for payment mechanics via Iberclear and any follow-on shareholder remuneration announcements.
